objects.summary: V2/V1 branch-aware router requires exact HEAD and canonical branch-specific specs, keeps four authority flags false and explicitly says old chats/default branch/historical file versions cannot define current work. Strong anti-stale-mission form.

Live-Lab branch router separates native live visualization from GitHub scientific memory, preserves concurrent V2 ownership, and explicitly refuses to claim Safari/iPhone qualification from Chromium emulation. Good example of proof-domain discipline.

Forensic/V2-preparation router makes CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE + live HEAD authoritative and says V2 trunk is not yet declared. Historical branch-cleanup instructions include a deletion script, but preservation of unique tips is required; this is historical cleanup intent, not current deletion authority.

Blue-era router explicitly retires the former PR12 mission, requires exact branch/base/Blue head/CI, and labels its own workstream summary a convenience superseded by later governance. Positive self-staleness warning, though still dependent on a large routing stack.

Variant of the Blue router adds organizational audit in startup sequence. Same bytes across edge-lab/runtime snapshots show the router was shared across rails, but the repeated startup surface also illustrates governance-reading overhead.

Deliberately minimal router forbids point-in-time workstream summary inside itself; state must live in referenced files. This is a direct attempt to eliminate stale frozen missions and is one of the cleanest anti-memory-drift designs in the historical family.

Blue router adds Fast Rail C as a bounded paper/shadow lane while retaining Gate-A/P14D/host/product separation and explicit no-capital authority. Demonstrates parallel-rail routing without automatic promotion.

Provider-independent SEC Form-4 Builder handoff pins exact base SHA and mission, explicitly forbids reviving PR12/old branch/market outcomes/self-certification, and ends at SUBMITTED_FOR_RED_TEAM. Strong bounded-build pattern.

The historical PR12 corrective mission itself: causal market timeline, crash-idempotent fills, strategy sleeves, IDLE liveness, post-transform risk and watchdog semantics, plus recomputation and truthfulness audit. It is valuable evidence of concrete defects being repaired, but becomes dangerous once reused after completion; later routers explicitly retire it.

Whole-system Builder mandate routes through North Star/Blue governance and tells Codex to reduce distance to the persistent Quant system rather than optimize ticket/code volume. It explicitly identifies PR7 worker and PR9 control-plane bootstrap as reusable prior work instead of rebuild targets.

October Codex router moves from September Blue to CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE/forensic baseline, keeps four authority fences, treats V2 as reconciliation not clean-room rewrite, and requires exact branch/HEAD plus durable evidence. Strong anti-branch-sprawl/rebuild discipline.

Early autonomous research-lead mandate asks for one end-to-end alpha-discovery vertical slice with OpportunityTicket, opportunity-map ranking, adverse validation, persistent memory and autonomous next action. It explicitly says not to inherit NASDAQ direction or build a giant platform first.

Earlier whole-system Builder mandate is semantically close to later version but lacks live-governance routing. It still emphasizes reusing PR7/PR9 primitives, coherent North-Star milestones and autonomous engineering rather than microtask completion.

Persistent Research Runtime mission explicitly says the first vertical slice already exists and must not be rebuilt; instead wrap it in restart-safe campaign state/queue/heartbeat so a Codex task ending is not campaign completion. Direct historical origin of IDLE!=FINISHED and anti-duplicate-work continuity.

Research-lead variant uses ResearchTicket rather than OpportunityTicket but retains the same vertical-slice, opportunity-map, negative-memory, adversarial evidence and autonomous-continuation design. Shows naming/interface churn around stable functional intent.

Provider-independent Builder revision explicitly subordinates Codex to BUILDER_ROLE and requires Red-Team handoff rather than self-certification. This is the mature correction to provider-specific authority ambiguity.

Tiny bootstrap receipt honestly records that HTTP 403 prevented fetching the intended remote branch and that alignment files only reflect supplied issue instructions. Good historical example of environment BLOCK not being laundered into remote-state proof.

Long autonomous-research bootstrap centers real net capital edge, forensic reality reconstruction, knowledge frontier, value-of-information experiment choice, preregistration, cheapest credible experiment, adversarial kill pass, hard KILL/REVISE/VALIDATE_MORE/PROMOTE decision and durable negative-memory ledger. Explicit anti-theatre law rejects complexity without evidence/economic rent.

Expanded Alpha-Factory bootstrap further broadens market selection, separates beta from alpha, requires material preregistration as separate commit, researcher/judge separation, strategy lifecycle and search-allocation learning. Strong scientific/economic doctrine, but a very large mandatory read surface that later token-efficiency rules appropriately compress.

Single launch entry point consolidates research loop and decision loop, explicitly says autonomy is not trading activity and NO_TRADE/REJECT are valid, requires autonomous continuation after failure and conditional capital selection only after economic gate. It preserves broad doctrine while being shorter than the full bootstrap stack.

cross_object_findings.finding: The historical PR12 corrective file was once the active mission. Successive CLAUDE_CURRENT_MISSION versions explicitly demote it to history and eventually forbid the router itself from carrying point-in-time summaries. This is direct documentary evidence that stale mission memory was recognized as a root cause and repaired.

OpportunityTicket vs ResearchTicket, research-lead vs Builder, Blue routing vs provider-independent routing all change, but the core intent remains: broad search, bounded vertical slice, persistent memory, adverse validation, autonomous continuation and no false alpha. Significant historical document churn was representational rather than new product intent.

CODEX Builder mandates explicitly identify PR7 and PR9 as reusable primitives and persistent runtime mission says not to rebuild the existing vertical slice. Later rebuild episodes therefore reflect execution/memory failures rather than absence of an articulated reuse principle.

The bootstrap documents already contain excellent value-of-information, preregistration, anti-theatre, beta-attribution and kill/continue rules. Their size and many mandatory reads created restart cost; later compact routers/delta-only handoffs preserve the important laws with lower context overhead.

The minimal bootstrap receipt explicitly records 403/no-remote access and refuses to claim inaccessible branch contents. This is an early positive example of BLOCK_ENVIRONMENT rather than fabricated repository certainty.
Bundle 0004 adds strong evidence about mission-router evolution, reuse doctrine and bootstrap overhead but introduces no current canonical code/runtime repair requirement.
